title: Iberian language
description: Extinct language of an indigenous western European people
extract: The Iberian language is the language or family of languages of an indigenous western European people, identified by Greek and Roman sources, who lived in the eastern and southeastern regions of the Iberian Peninsula in the pre-Migration Era. An ancient Iberian culture can be identified as existing between the 7th and 1st centuries BC, at least.
